# monetary value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:monetaryValue`](gmeow-monetaryValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/monetaryValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The numeric value of a monetary amount as an [xsd:decimal.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal.) Functional: a [`MonetaryAmount`](../classes/gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md) has exactly one numeric value.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:MonetaryAmount`](../classes/gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md) -> [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:monetaryValue`](gmeow-monetaryValue.md) from [`gmeow:MonetaryAmount`](../classes/gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md) to [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the bare numeric magnitude of a [`gmeow:MonetaryAmount`](../classes/gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md) — the decimal that, paired with [`gmeow:currency`](gmeow-currency.md), is a well-formed money value.

### Avoid when

- Avoid stating it without the [`gmeow:currency`](gmeow-currency.md) frame (a bare amount is ill-formed, [Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)), avoid it for unit-bearing physical quantities ([`gmeow:quantityValue`](gmeow-quantityValue.md)), and avoid two values — it is functional.

### How to use

- Put the amount here as [xsd:decimal](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal) and name the currency frame with [`gmeow:currency`](gmeow-currency.md); consumers read magnitude and currency together, and the frame-relativity shape rejects an amount missing its currency.

### Examples

- ex:price [`gmeow:monetaryValue`](gmeow-monetaryValue.md) 19.99.
